_comment: NEEDS_NEW_DSL for the second clause: 'When this hits a hero, banish it. You may play it this turn' needs banish-self + a play grant from banished, and no effect expresses that (BANISH_OPP_TOP_GRANT_PLAY is the opponent's deck). The previous implementation used BANISH target 'hero', which banishes the HERO — actively wrong, so it is removed rather than kept. The go-again clause below is expressible and correct.
